title: Fixed Coaxial Grip and Peel Edge Roll Lint Tool
description: One newly authored complete fixed lint-roller-style hand tool exterior. A whole long tapered grip continues along the same axis into a full central spindle. A complete open-ended tubular core supports the whole thick annular paper roll, and one finite full-width outer sheet edge follows the outer roll then curves away into a free peeling flap. The core is a genuine hollow tube occupied locally by its supporting spindle; the paper roll is an actual annular volume rather than a filled cylinder. One complete hand tool in a fixed side-lying pose, with the broad roll facet grounded and full grip cantilevering from it. Five closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole bounds-centred ground datum. All new numeric geometry, not a paint roller shank shortened or fabric shaver grille removed. One original model zero scenes. Static artistic exterior only: no lint, adhesive chemistry, removal effectiveness, peel motion, replaceability, rotating joint, hand fit, hygiene, load, manufacture or safety capability.
